description.content:
Retrieves details of education facilities near a property.
The response includes an array of education facilities, which includes all 'zoned' schools and up 5 additional nearby schools for primary and secondary school types.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier for a property</br> Refer to [Obtaining a propertyId](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/guide#obtaining-a-propertyid)

response.name: OK

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier for a property</br> Refer to [Obtaining a propertyId](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/guide#obtaining-a-propertyid)

header.description: (Required) Provide your bearer token as a string, in the format Bearer {access_token} in the Authorization Header Refer to Authentication
